cpp_stl_graph.title: High-Performance Graph Route & Priority Dispatch Engine (C++17 OOP & STL)
cpp_stl_graph.meta: C++17 · OOP · STL · Data Structures (Graphs, Min-Heap, Hash Maps, AVL Trees)
cpp_stl_graph.summary: Algorithmic C++17 route optimization and priority dispatch engine leveraging STL containers and custom graph data structures for sub-millisecond emergency and logistics routing.
responsibilities: Engineered weighted adjacency-list graphs using std::unordered_map and std::vector with Dijkstra and A* shortest-path algorithms running in O((V + E) log V) time.
Implemented a real-time dispatch queue using std::priority_queue with custom comparator functors and an AVL binary search tree index for fast node lookup.
Benchmarked across 10,000+ nodes and 45,000+ edges: achieved 0.42 ms average shortest-path query latency and zero memory leaks under RAII smart-pointer management.
cpp_stl_graph.architecture:
[Weighted Graph: std::unordered_map<int, std::vector<Edge>>]
       │
       ├──► [Priority Dispatch Queue: std::priority_queue<Task, vector<Task>, Compare>]
       │           │  O(log N) Urgency Extraction
       │           ▼
       ├──► [Dijkstra / A* Shortest-Path Engine] ──► O((V + E) log V)
       │
       └──► [Benchmark Results: 10,000+ Nodes | 0.42 ms Avg Latency | 100% RAII Safe]
cpp_stl_graph.tools: C++17 · OOP · STL (priority_queue, unordered_map, vector, set) · Data Structures (Graphs, Heaps, AVL Trees)
